focus_areas: Text legibility and correctness on the hull.
Structural integrity of the gondola attachment.
Surface smoothness and absence of melting artifacts on the envelope.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the rendering of the 'GOODYEAR' text. AI models often struggle with curved text on cylindrical surfaces. Verify if the letters maintain consistent thickness and perspective alignment. Also, inspect the gondola for realistic mechanical details versus generic 'blobby' shapes. Crucially, use the open_vocabulary_detector results to confirm if propellers are truly missing or just poorly rendered/occluded.
image_description: A yellow and black airship (blimp) flying against a clear blue sky. The airship features prominent text on the side, a gondola suspended beneath the forward section, and tail fins at the rear. The hull is elongated and cigar-shaped.
